findings.impact: The residual benchmark measurements used to reject both candidates have no retained raw receipt, hashed result, or executable candidate implementation. The commit therefore cannot substantiate that the requested benchmark was executed or independently reproduce its numerical results; it supports only a conservative retrospective rejection note.
findings.minimal_fix: Commit a machine-readable raw measurement receipt and the exact executable candidate/harness bound by hashes, or explicitly mark A1 as unverified/not completed rather than covered by executed results.

findings.impact: The report calls the lifecycle scores “Independent model judgments,” while the underlying heldout report says the author and judge were models from the same Gemini provider family and that the Naia-side agent controlled design and execution, so the judgment cannot be considered independent. This promotes model-judged diagnostic evidence beyond its recorded evidence class.
findings.minimal_fix: Replace “Independent model judgments” with “engine-blinded Gemini model judgments” and carry forward the same-provider, designer-involvement, and non-independent-adjudication caveats.

findings.impact: The manifest asserts PREFLIGHT_CLEAN but records a null complexity digest and points to an unspecified future/release receipt. Commit 1164723 contains no immutable preflight identity or reproducible preflight receipt, so the claimed deterministic validation cannot be tied to the reviewed artifact identity.
findings.minimal_fix: Commit the preflight command/output receipt with the tested commit/tree identity and non-null complexity SHA-256, then reference that receipt from both report and manifest; otherwise record the preflight as unverified.
